title: AlexNet — IT 论文精读 Paper 3

questions.question: AlexNet 在 2012 年胜出，它的核心贡献最准确的描述是什么？
options: 把 CNN、ReLU、GPU、Dropout 等已有要素凑齐，首次在百万级图像上训通大而深的网络
首次提出了 ReLU 激活函数，并从理论上证明了深层网络为什么比浅层网络更有效
首次发明了卷积神经网络，用卷积核滑过整张图的方式取代了此前所有的全连接网络
设计了一套比 SIFT、HOG 更精巧的手工特征，再交给 SVM 分类，从而大幅降低错误率
questions.explanation: 文章说得很诚实：AlexNet 没有全新理论，CNN 来自 LeCun，ReLU 也非首创，它的功劳是把零件组装起来并在规模上跑通，是一场数据、算力与工程的胜利。它恰恰抛弃了手工特征，让网络自己学；为何有效至今也缺少充分的理论解释。
questions.question_en: What is the most accurate description of AlexNet's core contribution in 2012?
options_en: Combining existing pieces (CNNs, ReLU, GPU training, dropout, data augmentation) to train a large deep network on a million natural images for the first time
Introducing the ReLU activation function and proving theoretically why deep networks outperform shallow ones
Inventing the convolutional neural network, replacing all earlier fully connected networks with kernels that slide across the image
Designing hand-crafted features more refined than SIFT or HOG and feeding them to an SVM, cutting the error rate sharply
questions.explanation_en: The piece is candid: AlexNet brought no new theory. CNNs came from LeCun and ReLU wasn't new either; its achievement was assembling the parts and making them work at scale, a victory of data, compute and engineering. It discarded hand-crafted features in favor of learned ones, and why it works still lacks a full theoretical account.

questions.question: AlexNet 把激活函数从 tanh 换成 ReLU，训练快了约 6 倍。原因是什么？
options: ReLU 是线性函数，整个网络因此等价于一层，参数量大幅减少、训练自然更快
ReLU 能起到正则化作用，压住过拟合，使模型在更少的训练轮数内达到收敛
ReLU 把一半单元的输出随机置零，减少了每一步的计算量，所以每轮训练更快
ReLU 正区间不饱和、梯度恒为 1；tanh 两端饱和、梯度趋零，深了就学不动
questions.explanation: tanh 和 sigmoid 在输入很大或很小时曲线压平、梯度趋零，深网络收敛极慢；ReLU 负的归零、正的原样输出，正区间永不饱和。随机置零一半单元是 Dropout 的做法；网络若真是线性的，再多层也只等于一层，正是需要非线性激活的原因。
questions.question_en: AlexNet replaced tanh with ReLU and trained about six times faster. Why?
options_en: ReLU is linear, so the whole network collapses to one layer with far fewer parameters, which naturally trains faster
ReLU acts as a regularizer that curbs overfitting, letting the model converge in fewer training epochs
ReLU randomly zeroes half the units' outputs, cutting the computation per step so each epoch runs faster
ReLU doesn't saturate for positive inputs and keeps a gradient of 1, while tanh saturates at both ends and its gradient vanishes in deep nets
questions.explanation_en: tanh and sigmoid flatten out for large or small inputs and their gradients approach zero, so deep networks converge very slowly; ReLU zeroes negatives and passes positives unchanged, never saturating on the positive side. Randomly zeroing half the units is dropout, and a truly linear network would collapse to one layer, which is exactly why a nonlinearity is needed.

questions.question: AlexNet 在训练时随机把全连接层一半单元的输出置零（Dropout），目的是什么？
options: 模拟图像中的遮挡和噪声，相当于对训练图片做了一次数据增强
逼网络别依赖少数单元的「小圈子」，学出稳健冗余的特征，压住过拟合
让网络在推理时也只用一半单元，以加快上线后的识别速度
减少一半的计算量，让 6000 万参数的网络能塞进两块 3GB 的显卡
questions.explanation: 6000 万参数极易把训练集背下来；Dropout 每次前向换一批单元缺席，逼每个单元离开固定搭档也有用，相当于低成本地平均海量子网络。拆到两块 GPU 是显存所迫的工程妥协，和 Dropout 无关；数据增强是另一招，靠翻转、平移和调色扩充样本。
questions.question_en: Why did AlexNet randomly zero half the outputs of its fully connected units during training (dropout)?
options_en: To simulate occlusion and noise in images, which amounts to a form of data augmentation on the training set
To stop the network from relying on small cliques of units, forcing robust, redundant features and curbing overfitting
So the network would also use only half its units at inference time, speeding up recognition after deployment
To halve the computation so the 60-million-parameter network would fit on two 3 GB graphics cards
questions.explanation_en: With 60 million parameters the net could easily memorize the training set; dropout benches a different set of units on each pass, so each unit must be useful without fixed partners, like cheaply averaging many subnetworks. Splitting across two GPUs was a memory-driven compromise unrelated to dropout, and data augmentation was a separate technique using flips, shifts and color jitter.
